items.question: Can Starter run real AI workflows?
items.answer: Yes. Starter is designed for scenario validation with limits on projects, workflow runs, and indexing to prevent abuse.

items.question: Can I use my own model API key?
items.answer: Yes. Bring-your-own keys are encrypted on the backend. The frontend never stores provider secrets in plaintext.

items.question: Does Enterprise support private deployment?
items.answer: Yes. Enterprise can be tailored around data residency, network boundaries, model providers, backup, and restore requirements.

items.question: What if online payment is not enabled yet?
items.answer: Contact an admin or sales contact for now. The same plan model will carry forward when checkout is enabled.
